pretreatments.description: Heat shock treatment: Granular sludge was boiled at 90 °C for 30 min.
Aeration treatment: Granular sludge was aerated for 24 h using an aquarium pump with an air flow rate of 3 L/min.
Alkaline pre-treatment: pH of the granular sludge was adjusted to 12.0 ± 0.1 with 3 N NaOH and maintained for 24 h.
WFO pre-treatment: Saponified WFO solution was added at 15 g/L to granular sludge cultures, maintained for 24 h, then washed three times with tap water.
Mechanical degradation: Synthetic FW samples were mixed and shredded in a kitchen mill to make a homogenous blend.
